claim_boundary: This post-hoc Q18-S4 record prices, on the four 8-qubit licensed banks, the shots that estimate the ground Ritz root's residual norm against the shots that estimate its energy, at one matched standard error, under single-assignment fully commuting settings with uniform shots: the shipped greedy colouring and the isotropic cover, each at block size n. The estimator, its linearization, the derivative validator, the statistic and the tenfold bar are Q18-S1's. Every Q18 and Q18-S1 ratio was seen before the declaration, so commit order protects execution identity, not inference. The ratios are first-order and asymptotic, read from exact variances on each bank's determinant reference, a stabilizer state. They price shots only: not the diagonalizing circuits fully commuting settings need, not device time, not finite-sample intervals, not another allocation, and not H2O or any bank outside the four.

functionals_and_setting_variances.scope: Exact reference pairings of the four 8-qubit banks' S, H and K blocks, both functionals, and every fully commuting setting's one-shot variance on the determinant reference, each checked against matrix-free statevector action; these banks and bases only.

fully_commuting_cost_ratios.scope: First-order (delta-method) uniform and Neyman ratios from exact per-setting reference variances under single-assignment fully commuting settings; not a finite-sample cost, not device time, and not the diagonalizing circuits.

statistic.name: R
statistic.derivation: Uniform shots make a linearized estimator's variance V / N at N shots per setting, so a standard error s costs G * V / s^2 shots. sigma is read from sigma^2 through d sigma = d sigma^2 / (2 sigma). Matching the two standard errors at s, the s^2 cancels: R is the residual's shots over the energy's at any one matched precision, to first order
statistic.rationale: A decade is the unit this repository reads as material, as in Q16's word clause and Phase 16B's 10x modelled-shot rule. A residual within a decade of its energy's shots is a by-product of measuring that energy well; beyond it, it is a measurement of its own. A ratio exactly at ten is affordable
statistic.matched_precision: Matching the standard errors of E and sigma makes both ends of the measured Weinstein interval [E - sigma, E + sigma] carry the two sources equally
statistic.linear_regime: d sigma = d sigma^2 / (2 sigma) holds while the standard error of sigma^2 is small against sigma^2. At a matched precision s that error is 2 sigma s, so the record reports matched_precision_half = sigma / 4, the s at which it reaches one half of sigma^2. Finer precisions are where R describes the cost; coarser ones do not resolve sigma from zero. No clause reads it
statistic.diagnostics: the record also reports the Neyman ratio, both sides at variance-optimal allocation across settings, (sum_g sqrt v_g)^2 in place of G * V. No clause reads it

grouping.energy_universe: the measured (S, H) universe: the raw U_SH, the (S, H) bank's words over the retained block, minus the identity, listed in ascending code order exactly as the mapping-axis producer lists its JW arm
grouping.residual_universe: the measured combined universe: the raw U = U_SH | U_K minus the identity. The raw U is every word a measured second-moment bank's rows carry, and the H-squared preflight record committed its size and SHA-256
grouping.universe_convention: Raw universes include the identity, as the Phase 2M-A ledger, the H-squared preflight record and the mapping-axis record count and hash them; every frozen basis starts with I, so S_00 carries it. Measured universes are the raw ones minus the identity, whose mean is 1 and is never measured. Every count and digest in measured_before_freezing whose name starts with raw_ is a raw quantity; measured_sh_words and measured_combined_words are one fewer, and every grouping partitions a measured universe
grouping.variance: per setting, Var_psi(sum_{w in g} f_w P_w) on the exact reference, by run_mapping_axis._functional_variance, the function behind the committed mapping-axis energy variances. V is their sum: the estimator's variance at one shot per setting

protocol_definitions.fc_greedy: clifford_qc.measurement.block_commuting.block_commuting_partition(n, codes, n) on the measured universe listed in ascending code order. One block spans the register, so a setting is any pairwise commuting set. Words are placed largest conflict degree first, ties by code, into the first setting they commute with.
protocol_definitions.fc_isotropic_cover: clifford_qc.measurement.regrouping.isotropic_cover(n, codes, n) on the same list. Each setting grows as an isotropic subspace: every generator is the compatible word that brings the most unassigned words into its span, and the setting takes every unassigned word the span contains.

grouping.rationale: Two constructions of one fully commuting rule, as Q18 declared two QWC ones, so that no status rests on one heuristic. Both are deterministic functions of the word set, and neither claims a minimum setting count. The greedy is the package's shipped colouring; the cover is the regrouping module's strongest construction at block size n.
grouping.measurement: A fully commuting setting is read through a Clifford diagonalizer, so each one-shot outcome is an eigenvalue of sum_{w in g} f_w P_w, and its variance is Var_psi of that sum: the formula Q18 applies to a QWC setting. The diagonalizing circuits carry two-qubit gates, and they are not priced.
grouping.statevector_check: Every setting variance from run_mapping_axis._functional_variance, an operator square, must equal <O^2> - <O>^2 from matrix-free action on the reference statevector within 1e-9 of max(1, <O^2>, <O>^2).

derivative_validation.rule: Evaluate all four central differences. Richardson R(h)=(4 D(h/2)-D(h))/3. Both final pairs must match the analytic derivative within relative_tolerance*||g|| + propagated RESOLUTION*cancellation_scale/h; they must also agree within the relative term plus both propagated floors. Every endpoint retains full rank and the declared nondegenerate ground root. No step is selected based on its discrepancy.

excluded.h2o_cas8e6o: Both fully commuting partitioners build a W x W conflict-mask table. At H2O's 868,149 measured words that is about 7.5e11 pairs, and the package ships no scalable fully commuting cover. Building one would be a new heuristic, not this question. H2O's Q18-S1 reading under QWC, R = 1,579, stands.

successor.disclosure: Q18-S1's NONE closes the uniform QWC estimator on the five banks. This successor changes only the partition, to the fully commuting endpoint Q18 and Q18-S1 excluded from cost, and drops H2O, where no fully commuting partition is feasible. Every predecessor ratio was seen, so the design is post hoc; commit order protects execution identity only.

declaration.config_claim_boundary_at_landing: This config declares a post-hoc Q18-S4 successor to Q18-S1 and carries no execution result. It prices the ground Ritz root's residual norm against its energy under single-assignment fully commuting settings with uniform shots, on the four 8-qubit licensed banks, with Q18-S1's estimator, statistic and tenfold bar. FULL or RESTRICTED licenses building that estimator on the affordable banks, subject to a separately preregistered sampled validation. No verdict makes a sampled, device-time, correlated-reference or quantum-advantage claim. NONE closes the fully commuting uniform estimator on these four banks.

decision.consequence: Post-hoc fully commuting closure: no finite-shot second-moment estimator under uniform single-assignment fully commuting settings on these four banks. With Q18-S1's NONE, the uniform single-assignment estimator closes negative at both grouping endpoints the package ships, on these banks. Exact residuals, convergence reports and folded roots remain available.

executed_evidence.label: asymptotic
executed_evidence.statement: First-order (delta-method) variances at large shot counts, computed exactly from each bank's determinant reference and frozen basis. No sampling, no seed beyond Q18-S1's finite-difference direction, no finite-sample claim.
